correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md blob 52f6550d. For diameter-two graph and s2>=2, any color i>=2 occurs on at most one vertex; color 1 must be independent. Each high-colored vertex radius>=2 dominates the entire graph. A domatic block consisting only of color-one vertices must comprise the ENTIRE color-one class A and it is dominating iff A is a maximal independent set (otherwise an omitted member of A has no color-one neighbor). Thus largest color t>=k and >=n-alpha+1. A maximum independent A of size alpha and distinct high colors on complement attains c=n-alpha+1 with c dominating blocks; merging handles k<=c. For k>c, t=k iff a maximal independent set of size n-k+1 exists; otherwise t>=k+1, achieved by independent A of size n-k and k distinct high-colored singleton blocks, distributing A among blocks. The proof also handles k=n by allowing A empty. This proves all integer k in 1..n and all specified sequences, not merely ordinary packing and finite graphs n<=5.
